title: Children and Candies (ABC Edit)
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

There are $N$ children in AtCoder Kindergarten. Mr. Evi will arrange the children in a line, then give $1$ candy to the first child in the line, $2$ candies to the second child, ..., $N$ candies to the $N$-th child. How many candies will be necessary in total?

## Constraints

- $1≦N≦100$

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N
```

## Output

Print the necessary number of candies in total.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

AtCoder 幼儿园里有 $N$ 个孩子。Evi 老师会让孩子们排成一队，然后给队伍中的第一个孩子 $1$ 颗糖果，给第二个孩子 $2$ 颗糖果，……，给第 $N$ 个孩子 $N$ 颗糖果。一共需要多少颗糖果？

## 约束条件

- $1≦N≦100$

## 输入格式

输入通过标准输入给出，格式如下：

```
N
```

## 输出格式

输出所需糖果的总数。

samples.note: The sum of the integers from $1$ to $10$ is $55$.
Only one child. The answer is $1$ in this case.
